title: Section action of the transported finite ordinary compositor
statement: Fix l,E,n,R and maps h:U→V and k:V→W. The transported intrinsic ordinary compositor acts on every module section by restriction along the geometric pullbackComp h k. Its construction uses the three scalar-map equalities of [lem-sf-finite-ring-scalar-map-equality]. No coefficient-composition equality, derived category, properness, compactification, or witnessed origin is needed.

theorem finiteTransportedOrdinaryCompositor_normalization
    {U V W : Scheme.{w}} (h : U ⟶ V) (k : V ⟶ W) :
    let R := PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
    ∀ (N : proEtaleRingModules U (R.ring U)) (T : W.ProEt)
      (m : N.val.obj (Opposite.op ((proEtaleBaseChange h).obj
        ((proEtaleBaseChange k).obj T)))) ,
      ((finiteTransportedOrdinaryCompositor l E n h k).hom.app N).val.app
          (Opposite.op T) m =
        N.val.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp h k).hom.app T).op m
